verdict.rationale: Undermind exposes a first-party MCP server with tools mirroring key UI capabilities (deep literature review, full-text PDF Q&A, note creation, folder curation, starring) and separately advertises a 'Programmatic queries via API' feature for enterprise customers, showing real intent toward API-level parity. However, probes found no public OpenAPI spec, docs, or llms.txt (404s), and the enterprise API is not documented enough to confirm it covers the full UI surface (e.g., alerts/notifications, workspace management). Missing for 10: publicly documented/openapi-verifiable API, evidence of full feature parity beyond MCP tools, and independent confirmation the enterprise API actually mirrors all UI functions.
